title: Disjunction is unchanged by deduplication
statement: For every list $l$ of natural numbers and every Boolean-valued predicate $p$, the listwise disjunction of $p$ over the duplicate-free version of $l$ equals its listwise disjunction over $l$.
hypotheses_covered: $l$ is a list of natural numbers
